name: WorkspaceRestoreCheckpoint
description: 从已发布 Artifact 的 workspace checkpoint 恢复 before 或 after 快照。可提供 artifactUri，或仅提供 checkpointId 让宿主从已发布 Artifact 中自动选择最新匹配项。宿主根据 Artifact 对侧快照推导并实时校验当前 workspace revision；内容完整性校验失败或 workspace 在读取期间变化时拒绝写入。

artifactUri.description: Artifact URI containing the captured workspace checkpoint.

checkpointId.description: Optional durable checkpoint id. When artifactUri is omitted, the host selects the newest matching Artifact.

currentRevision.description: Legacy optional revision hint. The host derives the expected revision from the checkpoint and verifies the live workspace itself.

target.description: Snapshot side to materialize. after resumes the captured change; before restores its base.

Capabilities.Title: Restore workspace checkpoint
Capabilities.Description: Restore a before or after workspace snapshot from a durable Artifact without overwriting unrelated files.

Notes: The host derives the expected current revision from the opposite checkpoint snapshot and rejects stale workspaces before writing.
Paths absent from the captured snapshot are never deleted implicitly.

UseCases: 恢复长期任务在 Artifact 中保存的 workspace checkpoint。
只凭 checkpointId 接管最近的 workspace checkpoint。
在宿主确认当前 workspace revision 后回滚到变更前快照。
从中断的子代理任务恢复其最后一个可验证的工作区结果。
Examples: 恢复某个 Artifact 的 after checkpoint
在 revision 冲突时安全拒绝回滚
Avoid: 没有 Artifact checkpoint 时不要使用；先通过 ArtifactMemoryRead 获取 evidence。
不要依赖或伪造 currentRevision；宿主会从 Artifact 对侧快照和实时 workspace 状态重新计算。

approval.Reason: 恢复或回滚工作区文件。
